summary: Directory of handpicked brand style guide documents from real companies, as PDF, web or Figma presentations.
description: A curated collection of brand guidelines from companies such as Adobe, Spotify, Dropbox, Starbucks, IBM, Duolingo and Miro, available as PDF documents, web versions or Figma presentations. A paid shop sells ready-made brand guide templates in Figma (Form, Owire, Cobalt and more). Free to browse; you can submit your own guidelines.
